description: Dividing a positive number by a negated zero gives negative infinity
notes: The spec's numbers have a single zero, so if division by zero gives an infinity at all (itself disputed), 1 / -0 is the same as 1 / 0. hashicorp/hcl keeps math/big's signed zero: Value.Negate turns 0 into a negative zero, and Float.Quo gives an infinity whose sign combines the signs of both operands (Value.Divide in cty/value_ops.go).
